bullets.text: The Plan changes shared behavior but does not account for all consumers affected by that change.
The Plan prevents a problematic value from reaching one operation while leaving it reachable by another operation with the same precondition.
The Plan applies a required correctness rule to only some equivalent values or locations in the changed operation.
The Plan changes one branch so that a documented output contract is no longer satisfied for every supported input.
The Plan introduces a new representation while retaining an older one without defining how both remain valid when read.
The Plan changes an accessor from reporting actual state to reporting remembered inputs without addressing possible divergence.
The Plan changes internal state without accounting for existing outputs derived from that state.
The Plan avoids evaluating an operation instead of producing the behavior required by the task.
The Plan's rationale depends on repository behavior that the referenced code does not have.
